name: Brilliant Diamond / Shining Pearl
notes: This config models BDSP as a location graph for the Route Builder.
Connections are intentionally broad and mostly ungated so the graph is useful as a prototype.
Trainer fights, wild encounters, items, and story-state restrictions can be layered on top later.
